6. MEASURE CLEARANCE OF SHIFT FORKS AND HUB SLEEVES

Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the hub sleeve and shift fork.

Maximum clearance: 1.0 mm (0.039 in.)

If the clearance exceeds the limit, replace the shift fork.

7. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE INPUT SHAFT BEARING

(a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

(b) Using a press, remove the bearing.

(c) Using a press and SST, install a new bearing.
SST 09506-35010

(d) Select a snap ring that will allow minimum axial play and install it on the shaft.
